name: Chupa Shite Ageru ~Sports Club no Onee-san~
original_name: ちゅぱしてあげる～スポーツクラブのおねえさん～
source:
Summer holiday! Masahiro is a university student and lives at an apartment. One day, he meets a beautiful girl, Sakura, at a coin laundry. She actually lives next to his room. He is happy to hear that, but he is forced to move because the apartment needs to be repaired. He sadly says good-bye to Sakura and moves to a new apartment where a sports club is located nearby. He soon starts working part-time there, but his part-time life is surrounded by sexy and erotic girls. Sakura is also a member of the club. Like this, his exciting and sweet summer holiday starts....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
暑假到了！大学生正宏住在一间公寓里。一天，他在自助洗衣店遇见美丽少女樱，原来她就住在自己隔壁。正宏得知后十分高兴，却因为公寓需要维修而被迫搬走。他依依不舍地与樱告别，搬进一处新公寓，附近正好有一家体育俱乐部。正宏很快开始在那里兼职，身边却围绕着许多性感而充满诱惑的女性。樱也是俱乐部会员。就这样，他既刺激又甜蜜的暑假开始了…
